name: eskais-mockup-cli
title: Mockup CLI
description: The mockup CLI the eskais-mockup skill runs: inspect the project's components, build a screen into one offline HTML file, validate it and write a gallery of its screenshots. Bun 1.4 or newer runs it from .agents/tools/eskais-mockup with no npm dependencies; it reads the project's components.json, stylesheet and tsconfig.

files.content:
// The Eskais UI release this CLI came from, written by the registry build.
export const version = "0.2.11"

docs: Run it from the project root with Bun 1.4 or newer: `bun .agents/tools/eskais-mockup/cli.ts inspect`, then `validate <name>`; `--version` prints the release it came from. It needs a TypeScript project (`tsx: true` in components.json): shadcn renames `.ts` files to `.js` in a JavaScript project, and Bun can't run them. The folder starts with a dot, so TypeScript's `include` globs leave it out of the app's type-check and build; a linter that walks every file still reads it, and it passes Vite's ESLint config and `lint-rules`. Update it with the registry: `npx shadcn@latest add @eskais/eskais-mockup-cli --overwrite`.
